risks.proof: A photo showing the full setup from the front and side where both machines are visible at once (or close-ups of both machine heads).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a single used sewing machine on a cabinet table.

risks.risk: Working condition (motor/handwheel movement, stitching function) is unknown.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine running and stitching (or at least turning smoothly) with the needle moving.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested / not guaranteed working.

risks.risk: Missing parts (needle, bobbin case, presser foot, belt, motor parts) and accessories are unknown.

risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible wear.

proof_requests: Confirm and photograph both sewing machine heads clearly (front + side view showing two machines if they exist).
Video showing the machine running/turning and stitching (or at minimum smooth handwheel movement).
Photos of included accessories/parts (needle, bobbin/bobbin case, presser feet, belt, power cord/motor parts).
Close-ups of the cabinet condition (joints, legs, rust/cracks) and underside stability.
